title: MMIR Activation Simulator
principle: Free-first activation must always land on one useful next action without provider secrets, raw prompts, paid routes or public runtime exposure.
public_repo_rule: Fixtures are public-safe state labels only. They do not contain provider keys, pairing tokens, raw prompts, raw responses, billing data or private user content.

scenarios.label: First visit gets a free answer path
scenarios.user_goal: Land on MMIR and get immediate value before installing anything.
scenarios.simulated_signal: No backend profile, no local node, no first-chat receipt.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Use the free browser guide or start a local install only when needed.

scenarios.label: Missing connector maps to one device repair
scenarios.user_goal: Understand exactly what to install on this device.
scenarios.simulated_signal: Local node is unreachable on localhost.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Show one OS/device-specific connector repair card.

scenarios.label: Installer return resumes verification
scenarios.user_goal: Return from installer and have MMIR continue automatically.
scenarios.simulated_signal: mmir_local_return=1 and stored repair resume state.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Refresh connector, model discovery, proof and repair resume status.

scenarios.label: Connector online asks for one free model
scenarios.user_goal: Install a model that fits the current device without terminal work.
scenarios.simulated_signal: Connector is reachable, runtime exists, model count is zero.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Open model library with an installable free starter model.

surfaces.evidence: Install local AI to finish activation

scenarios.label: Verified local model reaches first chat
scenarios.user_goal: Use the newly live local model for a useful first answer.
scenarios.simulated_signal: Live local model proof succeeded and first_chat_ready is true.
scenarios.expected_next_action: Select the verified route and show Send first answer.

surfaces.evidence: Your local AI is ready in MMIR
